Select advancedbehavior records where patsim > 0.439. Inner join each record to transactionrecord on transactionrecord.transreg = advancedbehavior.translink. Group by transactionrecord.ordertypedist, treating NULL as a separate group, and return the order type mix and count of matched records for each group.
queries:
SELECT tr.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
       COUNT(*) AS matched_record_count
FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
INNER JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
WHERE ab.patsim >= 0.439
GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist

SELECT
    transactionrecord.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
    COUNT(*) AS matched_records
FROM advancedbehavior
INNER JOIN transactionrecord
    ON transactionrecord.transreg = advancedbehavior.translink
WHERE advancedbehavior.patsim > 0.439
GROUP BY transactionrecord.ordertypedist
